en.t: Time slipped by, and in the blink of an eye three years had passed.

units.source_text: 罗连到了弱冠的年纪，那个时候突然流传起奇怪的要好，说是在距离教堂不远处的坊间有一个伞铺的女儿和罗连互相倾诉。

en.t: When Loren reached the age of about twenty, a strange rumor of intimacy suddenly began to spread: people said that the daughter of an umbrella shop not far from the church and Loren were confiding in each other.

units.source_text: 这个铺子的老翁也是天主教徒，常常带着女儿来教堂礼拜，

en.t: The old man who owned that shop was also a Christian, and he often brought his daughter to the church for worship,

units.source_text: 祷告的时候，他的女儿经常对职司提炉的罗连暗送秋波。

en.t: and during prayers, his daughter would often cast flirtatious glances at Loren, who was serving with the censer.

units.source_text: 而且这个女子每次去教堂的时候，必定打扮的花枝招展，盯着罗连看，

en.t: Moreover, every time this young woman went to the church, she was sure to dress herself up splendidly and stare at Loren,

units.source_text: 此事让众教人纷纷侧目。

en.t: which made all the believers look askance.

units.source_text: 有人说看见此女子走路的时候，故意踩罗连的的脚，

en.t: Some said they had seen this young woman deliberately step on Loren's foot as she walked,

units.source_text: 并且看见两个人互相递送情书等。

en.t: and had also seen the two of them passing love letters and the like back and forth.
